message.content: The first recorded dinner date between Li Hua and Wolfgang this year occurred on April 30th, as indicated in the log entry dated 20260430_17:00. In this conversation, Wolfgang mentions inviting Li Hua to dinner at Venedia Grancaffe to celebrate his promotion, stating, "Hey! Just a reminder about dinner tonight at 6 PM at Venedia Grancaffe. Can’t wait to celebrate my promotion! 🎉🍝". Li Hua agrees, saying, "Sounds awesome! Can’t believe you got promoted, man! See you there! 🎊".
